subject: Staggered provisioning ladder + supplier commitment letters and cloud backstop
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus-oem.com>, procurement@orbiscloud.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Initial ask: firm lead windows + conditional commitment language for DEAL-7832

Elena / Orbis procurement team —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Quick summary of what we need to close timing for AcmeAI (DEAL-7832):

- Confirm firm earliest ship week(s) per SKU and the expiry date for the attached OEM quote (Nimbus_OEM_quote_v3.pdf).
- A supplier "commitment letter" that indicates a 30/60/90-day hold window on pricing and allocation conditional on a signed reservation (we can accept partial deposit or DocuSign).
- Visibility on whether Orbis Cloud can offer a one-time backstop reservation to cover the first 600 GPUs if Nimbus misses the first tranche.

High level constraints from AcmeAI: they want onboarding to begin no later than 2028-01-15; surface-level slack is ~30 days but finance needs clear invoice windows.

Attachments: Nimbus_OEM_quote_v3.pdf (price table + tentative lead times).

Ask: Elena — can you publish a short commitment letter (1 page) this week with dates and conditional language? Orbis procurement — can you confirm whether you have a reservation SKU we could use as backstop and list cost uplift?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Capacity & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
Note: attaching quote stub rather than full PDF in thread export.

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus-oem.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbiscloud.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T14:28:00Z
Subject: RE: Initial ask: firm lead windows + conditional commitment language for DEAL-7832

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear note. Quick responses inline: 

- Quote validity: the attached quote is valid through 2027-11-15. We can extend to 2027-12-15 if there is a non-binding reservation in HubSpot and a 10% refundable deposit.
- Lead times: current ETA for mass shipments is 12–16 weeks from PO date for the primary SKU (NIM-RTXA80), 18–22 weeks for the low-power variant. We can commit to a "shipment window" with a +/- 10 business day tolerance per tranche.
- Commitment letter: I can have a short commitment letter drafted by COB 2027-10-06 that includes a 30/60/90 hold ladder. It will be conditional on (a) PO within 7 days of signing the letter or (b) a 10% refundable deposit.
- Orbis backstop: procurement@orbiscloud.com has visibility; they indicated a reserved pool (OR-RESERVE-1) that can be used for a 6-week bridge at a 12% cost uplift and a minimum 200-GPU block. They will confirm if it can be applied to AcmeAI specifically.

Attached: provisional_schedule.xlsx — rough tranche schedule aligned to the quote.

We understand the 2028-01-15 onboarding target; we'll prioritize the NIM-RTXA80 tranche for earliest shipment.

Regards,
Elena Torres
Head of Strategic Accounts, Nimbus OEM

---
Attachment: provisional_schedule.xlsx (tab: proposed-tranches).

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus-oem.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T11:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Initial ask: firm lead windows + conditional commitment language for DEAL-7832

Thanks Elena — this is helpful. A few follow-ups from Redwood finance / commercial POV: 

1) Staggered delivery ladder: can we agree on 3 tranches (30% / 40% / 30%) tied to milestone invoices? Our ops team wants the first tranche (30%) to arrive no later than 2027-12-20 so engineering can start KV/cache tuning before the full fleet roll.

2) Conditional credit: if Nimbus misses tranche-1 date by >10 business days, Redwood would seek a per-GPU credit (suggested 1.5% of invoiced tranche per week delayed). We can accept that in the commitment letter if Nimbus agrees.

3) Orbis backstop: if Orbis can offer OR-RESERVE-1 for at least 200 GPUs with a firm delivery week, that materially reduces our risk exposure. Please confirm the specific weeks they can commit.

4) Legal: Marissa — can you prepare a one-page addendum template we can attach to the PSR that captures (a) tranche percentages & dates, (b) credit formula, (c) deposit terms?

Attachment: deal-committed-qd.docx (skeleton of commercial terms).

Ben
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-10-08T16:42:00Z
Subject: RE: Initial ask: firm lead windows + conditional commitment language for DEAL-7832

Karthik / Ben —

Thanks — AcmeAI is under strong pressure to begin the first onboarding sprint in early January. Two asks from procurement side that will speed approvals: 

- Can Redwood / Nimbus provide a hard week for tranche-1 (not a +/- window)? Finance needs a billing week to match their capital plan.
- Will Nimbus accept split delivery invoices so we can take ownership of the first 200 GPUs and Redwood/Nimbus hold the remainder until the full QA pass?

If you can get a commitment letter that lists a firm ship week and split-invoice acceptance I can expedite internal sign-off and get PO to you within 5 business days.

Rajesh Patel

rajesh@acmeai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus-oem.com>, procurement@orbiscloud.com, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@acmeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T15:04:00Z
Subject: Consolidated plan & next steps — staggered provisioning + Orbis cloud backstop for AcmeAI (DEAL-7832)

Team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per internal review (ops + finance + legal), propose the following consolidated approach so we can move to PO: 

1) Delivery ladder (agreed): three tranches — tranche-1: 30% (200 GPUs), tranche-2: 40% (260 GPUs), tranche-3: 30% (200 GPUs). Target hard ship week for tranche-1: 2027-12-18.

2) Commitment letter: Elena — request you publish the 1-page commitment letter with these specifics: firm ship week 2027-12-18 for tranche-1, 10 business day tolerance thereafter; price validity extended to 2027-12-15 conditioned on a 10% deposit; credit formula: 1.5% per week delayed beyond tolerance applied to tranche invoice.

3) Split invoicing: Nimbus agreed to split invoices by tranche; AcmeAI to accept partial ownership on tranche-1 and Redwood to escrow freight until QA sign-off on tranche-2/3 per the addendum. Rajesh — confirm that split invoicing satisfies your capital team's requirement.

4) Orbis backstop: procurement@orbiscloud.com please confirm OR-RESERVE-1 availability for week-of 2027-12-18 as a bridge for 200 GPUs at the 12% uplift. If Orbis cannot confirm by 2027-10-22, Redwood will require a binding deposit on Nimbus to hold allocation.

5) Action items & dates:
   - Elena: commitment letter and scoped schedule — due 2027-10-20.
   - Orbis procurement: confirm reserve or provide week availability — due 2027-10-22.
   - Marissa: draft one-page addendum capturing credits & split-invoice flow — due 2027-10-20.
   - Rajesh/AcmeAI: confirm split-invoice acceptance and final PO timeline — due 2027-10-22.

If everyone agrees, Ben will issue the standard PSR with the addendum and we will take the deposit flow through DocuSign (link below) to lock pricing.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/signer/ABC-commit-789
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/DEAL-7832

Thanks — I will coordinate follow-ups, but please flag if any of the above points need different wording.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Capacity & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
